name: Italian Sausage, Peppers and Onions (No-Rice Skillet)

fit.note: 420 cal in [400,650]; 8g carb <=35g; no seafood; skillet/sheet-pan scales to 14; budget pork-sausage + non-starchy veg. FIT.

dupe_check.evidence: Catalog 'Italian Sausage Penne with Peppers' shares protein (italian sausage), sauce (marinara) and veg (bell pepper + onion), but it is a penne PASTA dinner; this candidate is a deliberately no-starch skillet plate, so the starch/plate differs and it survives as a distinct low-carb dinner rather than a dupe.
also_considered: polish-leczo-kielbasa-peppers-stew (smoked turkey kielbasa, tomato stew, not italian-sausage skillet)

borderline.reason: Against italian-sausage-penne this is arguably 'sausage and peppers' with vs without pasta (protein+sauce+veg identical, only starch/method distinguish). Kept because the no-starch plate is a genuinely different dinner and is the whole point of a low-carb run, but decider should confirm the catalog wants both the pasta and the no-starch take.

cross_protein_collisions: Structurally identical to any low-carb TURKEY sausage + peppers + onions skillet another selector may hold (catalog already has rice-based turkey-sausage-and-peppers-rice-skillet; a no-rice turkey twin would collide with this).
Also collides with any chicken-sausage peppers-and-onions skillet in another pool. Same-dish-different-protein - orchestrator merge pass should pick one.
